method: build_txt2img, build_img2img, build_inpaint, build_outpaint, build_generate_anything, build_style_transfer
name: FLUX.2 [dev] (FP8 / GGUF)
notes: Released Nov 25 2025. FP8 ~13 GB VRAM, fits RTX 5060 Ti. Day-0 ComfyUI support. Up to 4 MP photorealistic output. Comfy-Org repackaged FP8 weights. GGUF variants at city96/unsloth. Non-commercial dev license. Direct supersession of Flux1 Dev across all flux-arch builders.

name: FLUX.1 Kontext [dev]
notes: Released May 30 2025, mature Jun 2026. 12 B multimodal flow-matching DiT. Instruction-following editing with better identity/pose/lighting preservation than VLM-edit approach. GGUF needed for 16 GB (bullerwins/FLUX.1-Kontext-dev-GGUF). Non-commercial. KontextInpaint pipeline in diffusers (FluxKontextInpaintPipeline) also available.

name: Ideogram 4.0 (nf4 variant)
notes: Released Jun 3 2026. NextDiT/Lumina2-family arch with Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder. #1 open-weight on Arena leaderboard Jun 2026. nf4 fits 16 GB comfortably. fp8 variant needs ~24 GB. Day-0 ComfyUI v0.24.0 support (Ideogram4Scheduler). JSON bbox layout control, hex color pinning, flawless text rendering. Non-commercial on HF; commercial use requires paid plan.

name: SAM 3.1 multiplex (sam3.1_multiplex_fp16)
notes: Released Mar 27 2026. Drop-in checkpoint for existing SAM3 nodes. Object Multiplex = shared-memory joint multi-object tracking, faster with no accuracy loss. Native ComfyUI support merged (PR #13408). File: sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors.

name: HyperSwap 1a / 1b / 1c 256
notes: Three ONNX variants (~403 MB each) from FaceFusion Labs. Native 256 px resolution vs inswapper_128 128 px — sharper identity transfer, better skin detail. ReActor PR #143 merged; drop into models/hyperswap/. Direct ONNX drop-in, no architecture change needed.

name: ComfyUI-RMBG v3.0.0
notes: v3.0.0 released Jan 1 2026. Unified node pack: RMBG-2.0, BEN2, BiRefNet, SDMatte, SAM3, GroundingDINO. Weights auto-downloaded. Install via ComfyUI Manager. Real-time background replacement + improved edge quality. Existing BiRefNet weights unchanged.

name: LTX-2.3 (22 B, distilled 8-step)
notes: Released Mar 2026, Apache-2.0. 22 B DiT. Up to 4K @ 50 fps, 20 s clips, native synchronized audio. Four variants: dev, distilled (8-step), fast, pro. GGUF: unsloth/LTX-2.3-GGUF. Full FP16 exceeds 16 GB VRAM — MUST use distilled FP8 or GGUF Q4 on RTX 5060 Ti. New IC-LoRA controls released Jun 2026: Union Control (Canny+Depth), Motion Track, HDR embeddings.

name: WAN 2.7 T2V + I2V (14 B)
notes: Released Apr 22 2026; ComfyUI Partner Nodes live May 13 2026. MoE architecture (high-noise + low-noise experts). Better prompt adherence, motion naturalism, multi-person I2V vs WAN 2.2. Weights on ModelScope; HF Wan-AI org mirror not confirmed as of Jun 17. Apache 2.0. 14 B GGUF Q4-Q8 + blockswap fits 16 GB (confirmed on RTX 5060 Ti by community).

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
notes: Released Nov 21 2025. 8.3 B with SSTA (selective + sliding tile attention), ~2x efficiency vs v1.0. 8-step distilled I2V variant Dec 5 2025 (~75 s on RTX 4090 vs multi-minute for full model). Comfy-Org repackaged weights: Comfy-Org/HunyuanVideo_1.5_repackaged. Verify if Spellcaster build_hunyuan_video is already pointing to 1.5 checkpoint before taking action.

name: SCAIL-2
notes: IN-WINDOW: paper Jun 9 2026; GitHub + ComfyUI workflows released Jun 13 2026. CVPR 2026 Findings. End-to-end character animation via in-context mask conditioning — no skeleton extraction, no OpenPose. Passes reference image + driving video directly. GitHub: zai-org/SCAIL-2. GGUF: realrebelai/SCAIL-2_GGUF (fits 16 GB). ComfyUI tutorial nextdiffusion.ai Jun 11. New builder slot suggested: build_scail2_animate.

name: FlashVSR / ComfyUI-FlashVSR
notes: CVPR 2026. One-step diffusion streaming VSR via locality-constrained sparse attention + tiny conditional decoder. ComfyUI node: 1038lab/ComfyUI-FlashVSR (also FlashVSR_Stable, FlashVSR_Ultra_Fast). Auto-downloads .safetensors on first run. Tiling + sparse_sage_attention fits 16 GB on RTX 5060 Ti. Better detail than ESRGAN per frame, slower. Additive path alongside existing ESRGAN builders.

name: Microsoft Lens (3.8 B)
notes: Released ~Jun 1 2026. 3.8 B dual-stream MMDiT. FLUX.2 semantic VAE + GPT-OSS-20B MoE multi-layer text. Comfy-Org/Lens packaged weights. Native ComfyUI v0.23.0. Apache-2.0 or similar open license. Extremely VRAM-friendly. Turbo distilled variant. Suggested builder: build_lens_txt2img.

name: NVIDIA PixelDiT (1.3 B)
notes: CVPR 2026 Best Paper Finalist. VAE-free pixel-space DiT. 1.3 B params, dual patch+pixel DiT, MM-DiT joint attention, Gemma2-2B text encoder. 1024 px native multi-aspect-ratio. Comfy-Org/PixelDiT weights. Native ComfyUI v0.23.0 (PR #14103). Trivially fits 16 GB. Different quality profile from latent-space models. Suggested builder: build_pixeldit_txt2img.

name: PiD decoder (ComfyUI-PiD)
notes: Native ComfyUI v0.23.0 (PR #14103). Reformulates VAE decode + super-resolve into one conditional pixel-diffusion pass. SDXL and Qwen-Image variants in v0.24.0. Drop-in decode upgrade for SDXL and Flux2 Klein builders. No new builder needed — insert into existing decode stage.

name: FLUX.2 Klein 9B-KV (KV-cache variant)
notes: Released Mar 13 2026. KV-cache for multi-reference tasks = ~2.5x speedup on multi-reference builds. FP8 variant available (~18 GB — exceeds 16 GB VRAM budget). GGUF Q4 needed: unsloth GGUF may fit 16 GB. Evaluate GGUF Q4 before recommending as drop-in. Additive for character-consistency multi-reference sheet generation.

name: BFS Best Face Swap LoRA (justusgeorge10)
notes: IN-WINDOW: created Jun 17 2026. LoRA for Klein 9B / Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. Instruction-following face swap without facial landmarks — new paradigm vs ONNX GAN. Multiple community forks appearing Jun 8-17. 12-14 GB VRAM. Additive capability.

name: BFS Best Face Swap V1–V5 (Alissonerdx)
notes: Klein 9B LoRA series (Head V1–V5, Face V1). Progressive improvements in anatomical consistency and expression transfer. MIT license. Last repo update Mar 2026; forks active Jun 8-17. Additive alongside existing build_klein_headswap. BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video variant exists for LTX-2.3 (Tier 3 pending validation).

name: OSDFace (CVPR 2025)
notes: CVPR 2025. Single-step diffusion face restorer (~0.1 s per 512x512). Uses Visual Representation Embedder + VQ dictionary + GAN guidance. Outperforms CodeFormer on FID/LPIPS/NIQE. Validated at NTIRE 2026 challenge. No packaged ComfyUI node — needs thin wrapper around inference script. Potentially Tier 1 once node ships.

name: InterLCM (ICLR 2025)
notes: ICLR 2025. 4-step LCM restorer treating low-quality image as intermediate LCM state. Better identity/semantic preservation than pure diffusion multi-step. Optional Real-ESRGAN background enhancement. No ComfyUI node — needs manual wrapping. Cited in NTIRE 2026 proceedings.

name: HunyuanWorld-Mirror (ICML 2026)
notes: ICML 2026 accepted. Single-pass feed-forward: image → point cloud + multi-view depth + surface normals + camera parameters + 3D Gaussians. Weights auto-download from HuggingFace. ComfyUI node: cedarconnor/ComfyUI-HunyuanWorld-Mirror (11 nodes). Could consolidate build_depth_map_v3 + build_normal_map into unified 3D pipeline. Verify actual VRAM on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB.

name: InfiniDepth (CVPR 2026)
notes: CVPR 2026, arXiv 2601.03252. Arbitrary-resolution depth via neural implicit fields. Replaces discrete grid prediction — fine-grained detail at any output resolution. Also supports monocular + depth-sensor fusion + 3D Gaussian Splatting output. No ComfyUI node yet. Potentially superior to Depth Anything v3 at high res. Needs community node wrapping.

name: LBM_normals (ICCV 2025 Highlight)
notes: ICCV 2025 Highlight, paper 2503.07535. SOTA single-step normal estimation via latent bridge matching. Companion models: LBM_depth, LBM_relighting on same org. Diffusers-compatible. No dedicated ComfyUI node yet. Low compute, easily fits 16 GB. Companion LBM_relighting may also be relevant to build_iclight.

name: WAN 3.0 (60 B)
notes: Released via cloud APIs (Together AI) Apr 2026. ~60 B params, native 1080p. Open weights expected mid-to-late Q2 2026 under Apache 2.0 but not confirmed on HF Wan-AI org as of Jun 17. 60 B at FP8 needs ~30-40 GB VRAM — well outside 16 GB budget. Monitor wan.video for open-weight announcement.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.5 (LATTICE 10 B + PBR)
notes: Paper arXiv 2506.16504 (Jun 2025). LATTICE shape model 10 B + PBR texture synthesis. Substantially outperforms 2.0/2.1. Weights not confirmed open-source as of Jun 2026; GitHub issue #111 on 2.1 repo unresolved. Monitor tencent/Hunyuan3D-2 HF repo.

name: FramePack-P1
notes: Preview results shown Jun 26 2025. Adds Planned Anti-Drifting + History Discretization to reduce long-video drift. No confirmed weight release as of Jun 17 2026. Monitor lllyasviel/FramePack releases page.

name: inswapper_512_live
notes: 512px native ONNX from InsightFace/DeepInsight. Awaiting ReActor issue #76 merge as of Jun 17. When merged, becomes Tier 1 direct replacement for inswapper_128. Monitor weekly.

name: ColorFLUX (CVPR 2026)
notes: CVPR 2026. FLUX-based colorization with SCT-ControlNet + BCL-Redux + FCA-LoRA + progressive DPO. Targets old-photo colorization. No public weights found as of Jun 17. USTC + Huawei Noah's Ark Lab — weights likely forthcoming post-CVPR (mid-Jun to Aug 2026).
